Default (no token) behavior is byte-identical to production. Harness decision logic (decideTurn/validation/routing/record-update) UNCHANGED and SHARED across providers; only transport differs.
endpointInstrumentation.behaviorPreserved: adaptive endpoint+policy tests 8+50 pass; build passes
endpointInstrumentation.parityVerified: trace-capture.realpath.mjs: both providers run the SAME instructions/context/decideTurn/validation/routing; sameSharedInstructions=true, sameParsedCandidateAccepted=true

dataset.note: No new trajectories or metrics added. Synthetic; not classroom evidence.

scorer.semanticUncertainty: flagged for human review, not auto-scored

harness.note: No behavioral Harness fix in this task; stable comparison target preserved. Endpoint (api/session-intake-ai.ts) unchanged.

driver.reviewCorrection: fills required fields incl. scope from student-authorized confirmField; corrections explicit with before/after + authorizedSource; no gold/scoring-target fill
driver.persistence: save_my_session_intake_chat (as student JWT); four-Session persistence + carryover verified offline on isolated fixture t1bench01
driver.costAccounting: known (actual) vs unknown (conservative reserve for unreported retries on success AND failure) kept separate; conservative budget guard (not a provable hard cap)
